1.consolidated_definition: En una competencia deportiva, infracción del reglamento consistente en una entrada brusca de un jugador contra un rival.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In a competitive sporting event, infraction of the rules consisting in a sudden entry by a player against an opponent.
